method: Executed each claimed v1 closure against the architecture's admission, snapshot-convergence, query, scanner/provider, Probe, and TCB boundaries. Used counterexamples that preserve the declared stage label while varying actual authority or whether new facts are materialized.

priorClosureAssessment.A2-C2-V1-01: PARTIAL: the two-level shape removes the literal snapshot-stage contradiction, but its pre-admission semantics now contradict snapshot-convergence/D9 and ExecutionId allocation.
priorClosureAssessment.A2-C2-V1-02: PARTIAL: the requested minimum tuple and consumer state are present, but cross-universe relations and the opaque subjectScopePartition remain unschematized.
priorClosureAssessment.A2-C2-V1-03: CLOSED AT SPECIFICATION LEVEL: PS-07 now uses one public Plan and two forced private strategies with exact-Coverage preconditions. Harness remains unimplemented.
priorClosureAssessment.A2-C2-V1-04: NOT CLOSED: PS-09 states denial but supplies no enforcement mechanism and conflicts with linked TCB rules.
priorClosureAssessment.A2-C2-V1-05: CLOSED AT MODEL LEVEL: requiredness and required fault/budget consequences are explicit; field-level schema/tests remain absent.

resolves.B-C2V2-01: OPEN-BLOCKER: every InvocationPlan failure is called pre-admission, contradicting ExecutionId-before-work and snapshot-convergence indeterminate Runs.
resolves.B-C2V2-02: OPEN-BLOCKER: PS-09 is an assertion without a capability-denial substrate; linked first-party TCB rules retain ambient authority.
resolves.B-C2V2-03: OPEN-BLOCKER: PS-12 says all effectful work is Probe-only although semantic providers and scanners perform filesystem/process/toolchain effects during fact derivation.
resolves.B-C2V2-04: OPEN-BLOCKER: domainResults makes Run creation depend on result kind, so stored rule/reduction reads create Runs while fact queries never do, even when analysis is required.
resolves.B-C2V2-05: OPEN-BLOCKER: the minimum Coverage key cannot unambiguously represent cross-language/cross-universe edges without source/target universe and exact partition schemas.
resolves.B-C2V2-06: OPEN-BLOCKER: no field-level stage or plan schema/validator exists, so closed-kind and unknown-field compatibility assertions are not executable.

evidence: InvocationPlan covers snapshot capture/sealing and allocation of PlanId and ExecutionId
failureBefore says any failure in that whole level is pre-admission and never a Run verdict
architecture/02 allocates ExecutionId at admission before work begins
architecture/03 and D9 classify exhausted snapshot convergence as indeterminate rather than request/operational failure
architecture/06 says every analysis attempt gets an identity and is recorded by default
findings.impact: The same snapshot failure has incompatible identity and termination semantics depending on which artifact is followed.
findings.requiredChange: Separate request validation from attempt admission. Allocate ExecutionId before snapshot work; allow snapshot capture/convergence to produce an attempted-analysis terminal with no ExecutionPlan/Run if that is the chosen model, or define a pre-seal AttemptRecord distinct from Run. Do not label contribution-resolution host faults and unstable-input exhaustion with one pre-admission rule.

evidence: PS-09 says runtime denies filesystem/network/spawn regardless of stage label
knownLimitations says no artifact designs that mechanism
architecture/05 places first-party imperative rules in linked TCB and says signatures/labels do not confine
findings.impact: The revision claims to close the exact ambient-authority blocker while recording that the required boundary does not exist.
findings.requiredChange: Move the property to a capability-enforcement artifact and make C-2 depend on it. Either require a restricted runtime for all Rule code or weaken the sealed property for linked TCB code; a conformance sentence alone is not mechanical denial.

evidence: PS-12 says effectful work is representable only as Probe
fact derivation includes semantic providers and external facts
architecture/05 semantic providers/scanners may read snapshot subsets, run compiler/toolchain processes, write ephemeral output, and under grants access network
Probe means an effectful scenario/observation, not every implementation side effect
findings.impact: A valid scanner/provider either violates PS-12 or must be mislabeled Probe, erasing its distinct Coverage and failure semantics.
findings.requiredChange: Define the prohibited class precisely: project/external-world scenario effects and mutation/network authority are not ordinary Rule authority. Permit supervised implementation effects for declared provider/scanner operators under typed capabilities without calling them Probe stages.

evidence: domainResults says fact/graph query createsRun false, rule findings and reduction candidates createRun true
architecture/05 and /08 say a query over stored facts never runs analysis, while explicit admission creates a Run
stored findings/reduction candidates can be queried without analysis; a fact query may explicitly admit missing derivation work
findings.impact: Run creation becomes a property of the response noun instead of whether new authoritative analysis was admitted.
findings.requiredChange: Model query/read and analysis admission orthogonally to result contract. Any stored-view result creates no Run; any request that materializes required facts/rules must use explicit analysis admission, whatever domain result is later projected.

findings.evidence: The key has one languageOrSemanticUniverseId and an opaque subjectScopePartition, while imports/calls/package cycles can cross source and target universes and scopes.
findings.impact: Complete source-side extraction can be mistaken for complete target resolution, and independent implementations can partition exact Coverage differently.
findings.requiredChange: Schema relation domain/codomain, source and target universe where applicable, scope-set commitment, resolution method/quality, and producer/schema identity. Demonstrate a cross-language edge and a negative query, not only parallel TS/Go partitions.
findings.confidence: medium-high; subjectScopePartition could encode this, but the artifact does not say so

evidence: knownLimitations admits stage field schemas are unspecified
PS-01/PS-02/PS-11 depend on a serialized schema with closed enums and private-field rejection
findings.impact: The binding object cannot distinguish a conforming Plan from one carrying private operators or missing required fields.
findings.requiredChange: Publish executable schemas for Invocation/Attempt/ExecutionPlan and all stages, plus positive/negative fixtures and a retained validator. Include unknown-major/kind behavior and canonicalization for PlanId.

sealedPropertiesCovered.assessment: One mechanism/private physical strategy direction remains plausible; v2 does not yet define a coherent full boundary.
Invocation failure semantics conflict with attempt identity and snapshot indeterminate classification.
PS-09/PS-12 do not discharge capability denial and overgeneralize effectful work.
Compound key improvement accepted; exact cross-universe partition semantics remain incomplete.

knownLimitations: I did not choose between an outer InvocationPlan and a non-Plan admission/attempt protocol; either can work if identity and termination boundaries are coherent.
PS-07's physical strategy test is accepted only as a specification because no harness exists.
The review does not enumerate every field required by each stage schema.

confidence.priorClosureAssessment: high except Coverage-key sufficiency, which is medium-high

whatWouldChangeOverallVerdict: A v3 with a coherent request/admission/attempt boundary, an actual Rule capability-enforcement dependency, a precise definition of Probe-exclusive effects, admission-orthogonal domain results, cross-universe Coverage schema, and executable closed Plan/stage schemas.
